quest.title: Pigeons Go AWOL
quest.description: Draff is angry at the pigeons he keeps...

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Regarding these pigeons...

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: They'd be more use to me roasted with a few wild mushrooms...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: I raised them as carrier pigeons, to deliver messages.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: But for some reason they are getting less and less reliable.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Either they lose the message or they glide around for hours but never actually deliver it. Or, they sit around the whole time just waiting for someone to chase them off.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: If you have time, maybe you could hurry along the pigeons I just released.

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: Great. So if you see any of them slacking off, chase them away for me.

choices.text: I seek not the enmity of pigeons.

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: Don't worry, it's not like pigeons to hold a grudge. Their memory is much too short for that.

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: I never had you down as such a pigeon lover...

talks.objective: Look for pigeons in the woods

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: These pigeons are such lazy slackers. Hurry them along, they need to learn to be good little pigeons and deliver those messages!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There! I doubt they'll be planning on slacking off again anytime soon...

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Regarding these pigeons...

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Maybe now they'll deliver their messages without a fuss in future...

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: But I can't exactly follow them and check... Anyway, that'll do for now.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: For your trouble, please take this. And if you ever need to send a message, just come and find me.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Regarding these pigeons...

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: You did WHAT? How could you!? They were my carrier pigeons!

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: You churlish imbecile... hilichurlish, even! What am I going to do about all these letters!?

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: Is that the best you can do? A Knight of Flaming Favonius and the best you can offer is a half-hearted apology!?

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: You've really fluffed up here, and now you have to make it right. Since you're so bird-brained anyway, I trust you will have no problem being my new carrier pigeon!

choices.text: Sometimes I don't know my own strength...

response.speaker: Draff
response.text: It helps if you don't chase them off with a flaming meat cleaver!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Dun-dun-dun! The pigeons are gone! Paimon swears they were here just a second ago...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look at those hilichurls, they're gathered round a cooking pot and there's a bit pile of meat by the side...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh, what's this? ...A message?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shoot, one of the pigeons must have dropped it on the way...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, see who the sender is. Maybe we can sort this out.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Chirp chirp, I have a letter for you.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: Oh! I never expected you to be the one delivering this!

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: I thought it would be a carrier pigeon, like usual.

dialogues.speaker: Sara
dialogues.text: But as long as it's delivered I'm happy. Thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Regarding these pigeons...

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Goodness... The devil makes work for idle hands, eh.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Alright, well never mind. I'll let you off this once. Off you go now.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Regarding these pigeons...

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: The hilichurls have an insatiable appetite for avian messengers? Are you serious...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is this letter yours?

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: A letter? Ah yes, I sent this! It was supposed to go to Sister Grace, in the city.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: You didn't read it, did you? Not that it matters anyway, it's all stuff that happened years ago.

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: With some things, you can't leave them in the dark forever...

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Thank you for bringing it all this way, I'll run it down to the city myself some time. Here's a small reward for finding it...

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Timmie, hey Timmie...

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: These pigeons are getting plumper by the day... What is Allan feeding them?

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Regarding these pigeons...

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: The hilichurls have an insatiable appetite for avian messengers? Are you serious...

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: Well, I suppose they are getting plump, and would probably make a great pairing with a glass of jagerschnapps...

dialogues.speaker: Draff
dialogues.text: ...I mean, uh... Oh drats, now I have to raise a whole new flock of pigeons.
